psychological_hook: What is this? It looks premium and powerful.
subtext: 40W Bluetooth Lantern Speaker with RGB Glow
prompt_flux: Professional product photography of a cylindrical portable bluetooth lantern speaker, matte black body with brushed metal accents, glowing with vibrant rainbow RGB LED light emanating from the top diffuser, placed on a dark slate surface, dramatic low-key lighting from the side, the RGB glow illuminates surrounding mist/fog creating colorful light rays, shot with Sony A7R IV, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, dark moody background fading to black, product centered in frame with slight upward angle, hyper-realistic material rendering showing metal texture and soft-touch rubber grip, cinematic color grading with deep blacks and vivid RGB highlights, 8K resolution, commercial product photography quality
prompt_ideogram: Professional product photo of a premium bluetooth lantern speaker with rainbow RGB LED glow on dark background. Bold white text "SOUND MEETS LIGHT" at top, smaller text "40W Bluetooth Lantern Speaker" below. Dark moody atmosphere with colorful light rays emanating from the speaker's LED diffuser. Cinematic product photography, 8K quality, dramatic side lighting, mist effects. The text should be clean, modern sans-serif font integrated with the lighting effects.
prompt_qwen: A premium bluetooth lantern speaker product photo, dark background, RGB rainbow LED glow from the top diffuser creating colorful light rays in misty atmosphere. Bold white title 'SOUND MEETS LIGHT' elegantly placed at top. Professional commercial photography, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, cinematic lighting, 8K resolution.
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, overexposed, cluttered background, cheap looking, cartoon, illustration, watermark, text artifacts, deformed product
style_notes: This is the hero shot. Maximum visual impact. The RGB glow is the star — it should light up the surrounding atmosphere. Dark/moody background makes the product pop. No humans in this shot.

psychological_hook: I can totally see myself using this at my next party.
subtext: Turn any gathering into an unforgettable experience
prompt_flux: A group of diverse young adults in their late 20s enjoying an evening backyard garden party, string lights overhead, a cylindrical black bluetooth lantern speaker with vivid RGB purple and blue LED glow sits on a wooden patio table in the foreground, people are laughing and socializing in the warm background bokeh, twilight sky with deep blue and orange gradient, warm ambient lighting mixed with the cool RGB speaker glow, shot at 35mm f/2.0 on full frame, natural candid composition with the speaker at lower-right third, warm skin tones, summer evening atmosphere, photojournalistic style, 4K quality
prompt_ideogram: Evening backyard party scene with friends socializing around a glowing RGB bluetooth lantern speaker on a wooden table. Bold white text "LIFE OF THE PARTY" overlaid at top, smaller text "Turn any gathering into an unforgettable experience" below. Twilight sky, string lights, warm ambient glow mixed with vivid purple-blue RGB light from the speaker. Natural candid photography style, 35mm lens, warm tones, 4K quality.
prompt_qwen: Backyard evening party, young friends laughing around a wooden table with a glowing RGB bluetooth lantern speaker. Twilight sky, string lights, warm atmosphere. White bold title 'LIFE OF THE PARTY' at top. Natural photography, 35mm lens, warm color grading, 4K.

style_notes: Lifestyle shot — natural, aspirational, warm. The speaker should be clearly visible but not dominating the frame. People are the emotional hook. Evening/twilight lighting creates atmosphere.

psychological_hook: Wow, 40 watts is seriously loud — and the light syncs to music!
subtext: Room-filling stereo sound with beat-synced RGB lighting
prompt_flux: Dynamic close-up product shot of a black bluetooth lantern speaker with visible sound waves and bass vibrations radiating outward from dual speaker drivers, RGB LED on top cycling through red-orange-yellow spectrum synced to an invisible beat, the speaker sits on a reflective dark surface creating mirror effect, dramatic rim lighting from behind highlighting the speaker grille texture, visible air distortion around the drivers suggesting powerful bass, dark gradient background, shot with macro lens perspective 50mm f/2.8, ultra-sharp detail on the speaker mesh and driver cones, energy and movement conveyed through light trails, commercial product photography, 8K
prompt_ideogram: Dynamic product shot of bluetooth lantern speaker with visible sound wave effects and vibrant RGB LED glow cycling red-orange-yellow. Bold white text "40W DUAL-DRIVER POWER" at top, smaller text "Room-filling stereo sound with beat-synced RGB" below. Dark reflective surface, dramatic rim lighting, sound energy visualization around the speaker. Modern tech product photography style, 8K quality, clean sans-serif typography.
prompt_qwen: Bluetooth lantern speaker with powerful sound wave visualization and RGB LED glow in red-orange spectrum. Dark reflective surface, dramatic rim lighting. Bold white text '40W DUAL-DRIVER POWER' at top. Tech product photography, 8K, dynamic energy.
negative_prompt: static, boring, flat lighting, no energy, cartoon sound waves, cheap graphics, cluttered text
style_notes: This sells the SOUND quality. Visual metaphors for power — sound waves, bass vibrations, energy. The RGB syncing to music is the secondary hook. Keep it dramatic and tech-forward.

psychological_hook: The build quality looks solid — premium materials, not plastic junk.

prompt_qwen: Extreme close-up of bluetooth speaker showing water droplets on waterproof surface, brushed aluminum accents, speaker mesh detail. White bold text 'CRAFTED TO LAST' at top. Macro photography, warm lighting, shallow depth of field, RGB bokeh, 8K.

psychological_hook: Let me check the specs — battery life, size, connectivity all look great.
subtext: Everything you need, nothing you don't
prompt_flux: Clean technical product layout photography of a bluetooth lantern speaker shown from a 3/4 elevated angle on a minimal dark charcoal background, the speaker is illuminated with soft even lighting showing all physical features clearly — the retractable handle on top, USB-C port, solar panel strip, speaker grille, RGB diffuser, physical buttons — subtle dimension lines and measurement indicators floating near the product, clean minimal composition with generous negative space around the product for text/icon overlay zones at top and bottom, professional catalog style photography, sharp focus throughout, 8K resolution, neutral color temperature
prompt_ideogram: Technical product layout of bluetooth lantern speaker on dark charcoal background. Bold white text "BUILT FOR ADVENTURE" at top. Clean spec callouts around the product: "20+ Hours Battery" "IPX5 Waterproof" "Bluetooth 5.3" "USB-C + Solar" "8 RGB Modes" "TWS Pairing" shown as minimal white icons with labels. Elevated 3/4 angle view, soft even lighting, professional catalog photography, clean sans-serif typography, 8K quality.
prompt_qwen: Technical product photo of bluetooth lantern speaker on dark background, 3/4 elevated angle. White text 'BUILT FOR ADVENTURE' at top. Spec icons around product: 20+ Hours, IPX5, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, Solar, TWS. Clean catalog style, even lighting, 8K.

style_notes: Specs/parameter image. Clean, informational, but still stylish. The dark background maintains brand consistency. Icons should be simple linear style. This is where Ideogram's text rendering really matters — or we use HTML template overlay.

psychological_hook: Solar charging AND a lantern? No other speaker does this.
subtext: The only 3-in-1 outdoor companion you'll ever need
prompt_flux: Split composition product photography showing a bluetooth lantern speaker in three scenarios seamlessly blended: LEFT third — the speaker hanging from a tent pole inside a camping tent at night, its warm white LED providing lantern light illuminating the tent interior; CENTER — the speaker outdoors in golden hour sunlight with its solar panel strip visibly absorbing sunlight, lens flare and sun rays; RIGHT third — the speaker at a beach bonfire with full RGB party mode casting colorful lights on sand, dark sky above. The three scenes blend through smooth gradient transitions. Each scene lit naturally for its context. Cinematic wide composition, 16:9 aspect feel compressed to square, warm to cool color progression left to right, 8K quality
prompt_ideogram: Triptych product image showing bluetooth lantern speaker in three modes: camping lantern (warm glow in tent), solar charging (golden sunlight outdoors), party speaker (RGB lights at beach bonfire). Bold white text "SPEAKER + LANTERN + SOLAR" at top, smaller text "The only 3-in-1 outdoor companion" below. Scenes blend through smooth gradients. Cinematic lighting per scene, warm-to-cool color progression. Clean modern typography, 8K quality.
prompt_qwen: Three-scene composite: bluetooth lantern speaker as camping lantern in tent (warm glow), solar charging in sunlight (golden hour), RGB party at beach bonfire. White bold text 'SPEAKER + LANTERN + SOLAR' at top. Smooth gradient transitions between scenes, cinematic lighting, 8K.
negative_prompt: single scene, boring composition, no differentiation, harsh transitions, collage look, cheap grid layout
style_notes: This is the differentiator — showing the 3-in-1 value proposition. The triptych/split composition is ambitious but very impactful if done well. May need template compositing if single-generation doesn't nail it. Each scene must look natural.
